evidence: Matches the P2P label and changes peer eviction handling during anti-DoS headers sync in src/net_processing.cpp and src/headerssync.h.
rationale: Fixes a chain sync liveness failure where peers on slow networks (such as Tor or I2P) are erroneously evicted after 22 minutes because headers presync progress is not recognized by chain sync eviction logic. As noted in the PR description, presync requires roughly 480 round trips, and latency exceeding ~2.5s per round trip causes nodes to repeatedly evict sync peers and restart headers sync from scratch. Resolving this restores reliable initial sync for high-latency connections without compromising chain sync eviction protections.
